benchmark.methodology: 20 measured steps after 5 warmup steps; external input constant; REAL graphs for Vulkan, SYNTHETIC_TEST for CPU (matches prior harness); seed 42; wall-clock via perf_counter.
design_conclusions: Per-step host readback overhead (median): [0.041, 0.0366, 0.0638, 0.0607, 0.2052] ms across sizes; state readback stays because CPU owns telemetry/motor/decoding state.

Plasticity readback vs no-readback medians: [(0.1562, 0.2057), (0.157, 0.1324), (0.1737, 0.1291), (0.388, 0.138), (1.029, 0.1739)] ms; weight readback is the dominant GPU->CPU cost on rewarded steps, motivating lazy weight sync (v4.1).

Host-visible upload bandwidth: [31.7, 183.1, 689.2, 2486.1, 4243.8] MB/s on unified-memory AMD iGPU; device-local+staging would add copies without benefit here, so the host-visible/coherent design is retained (measured, AMD-compatible).

Command buffer is re-recorded per step (reset + begin/dispatch/end); dispatch geometry is fixed per circuit so pre-recording is possible in principle, but re-record cost is inside the measured submit path and no material gain was demonstrated — retained as-is (no unmeasured optimization).
